description: Always-on AI agents from xAI and Cursor that work autonomously across your tools and apps.

pre_install: $procs = @(Get-Process -Name 'Grok Bot' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($procs.Count -gt 0) { throw 'Grok Bot is running. Quit it before install/update; Scoop will not stop the process.' }
$procs = @(Get-Process -Name 'Grok Bot' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($procs.Count -gt 0) { throw 'Grok Bot is running. Quit it before install/update; Scoop will not stop the process.' }

notes: This laelluo package is named grok-bot (same as extras). Prefer: scoop install laelluo/grok-bot. Or uninstall the extras package first, then install.
Quit Grok Bot completely before scoop install/update/uninstall. Scoop will not kill the process.
Update with: scoop update grok-bot. Turn OFF in-app auto-update (Settings).

On install, existing %APPDATA%\Grok Bot is migrated into persist\roaming with relative path and file size verification; the original is renamed to *.scoop-portable-backup. Confirm the app works, then you may delete the backup.

%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Grok Bot is intercepted by a file symlink to persist\programs\grok-bot-updater-blocker. Any existing directory at that path is treated as a stale NSIS updater tree and deleted; it is not user data.
If persist\roaming already has different data while AppData is still an ordinary directory, install refuses to merge.
Ordinary uninstall removes owned symlinks only; Scoop persist and *.scoop-portable-backup directories are kept.
